name: Delaiah
overview: The name Delaiah, also spelled Dalaiah, appears in Scripture associated with several individuals of notable standing within the post-exilic community and the royal lineage of Judah. Scripture identifies Delaiah as a leader within the priestly divisions, as seen in the genealogical records of those returning from Babylonian captivity (Ezra 2:60; Nehemiah 7:62), highlighting his role in the restoration of worship. Additionally, Delaiah is mentioned as a prince among the Judean nobility (Jeremiah 36:12, 25), involved in interceding for the preservation of God's word during a time of opposition. The presence of his son as a false prophet (Nehemiah 6:10) further illustrates the complex spiritual environment of the period. Collectively, these references underscore Delaiah's connection to the faithful remnant of Judah, entrusted with both leadership and responsibility amid challenging circumstances.
